title: Hourly WEF-Columbus Auto-Dig:Global Shapers archival status
summary: Dataset-first hourly pass on the queued Columbus Global Shapers archival target; preserves the launch locality without promoting it to headquarters, advances the activation-status evidence boundary, and records a no-filler August news scan.

provenance.method: dataset-first randomized Auto-Dig; primary-source archival-status review; bounded current-news search

data.research_question: Who attempted the Columbus Global Shapers launch, did it receive an official hub identifier, and was it paused, dissolved, or never activated?
data.method: Enumerated 27 physical dig roots on current main. Excluded free-range as the meta-root plus palantir, devil-corp, and cloarida as the previous three successful hourly roots, leaving 23 eligible dataset/topic roots. Dataset seed 16064152336099541867, derived from SHA-256(c80ec98372c0b2b1cde273470181b4dddad8ba8b|2026-08-18T20:00:00Z|hourly-auto-dig|dataset-first-v1), selected wef-columbus uniformly at dataset stage. The selected dataset exposed eight normalized queued depth-7 targets in the current primary-record frontier plus the newly queued AndHealth street-HQ target; target seed 8307007235874177759 selected starintel:investigation-target:wef-depth-7-columbus-shapers-archive. The location phase re-reviewed the Cleveland Hub project page and recorded Columbus, Ohio only as the planned hub locality. The archival-status phase re-reviewed current Global Shapers public discovery surfaces and exact-name queries. The post-location current-news sweep searched Global Shapers/WEF/Ohio/Columbus August 2026 results and found no material Columbus-Hub-specific event or correction, so no filler news event was created. The exact whole-corpus actionable-target total was not fabricated because connector indexing cannot reproduce the full Free-Range DB+packet terminal-state, blocker, legacy-transport, and deduplication pass.
classification_rules: dataset-first uniform selection after previous-three exclusions
planned launch locality is not headquarters
search non-discovery is not proof of nonexistence or dissolution
current-news ingestion requires material non-duplicate evidence

findings.finding: Global Shapers Cleveland still publicly describes a Columbus Hub as a launch it was supporting in Columbus, Ohio.
The bounded current Global Shapers review did not recover a current Columbus Hub page, official hub identifier, curator, or roster.
No reviewed source established whether the Columbus launch formally activated, paused, dissolved, or was rejected.
The August 2026 current-news sweep produced no material Columbus-Hub-specific update worth ingesting.
